dimension_notes labels ('overall width', 'T-slot opening', 'center bores', 'diagonal callout across the central cavity') are read from the drawings; the catalog prints only the numeric callouts.
Superscripts in Moment of Inertia and Surface Area / Modulus units are written as the characters ⁴ and ² (the text layer shows them as plain 4 and 2), matching the convention in other chunks.
